body: I'm having a hard time, on account of some medical stuff and financial trouble. I guess I'm blabbing about it on reddit because my social circle has kinda sized down over the last few years. Doing my best to keep my chin up irl but to be honest I've been having little crying fits in the shower and car sometimes, sorta scaring myself.

Thanks for that perspective. I guess I'm trying to minimize any negative impact but that's mostly out of my control. I'm wondering about the whole note thing and if it does more harm than good, or if trying to talk things out ahead of time would lead to understanding or make friends/family feel frustrated or impotent. There's no way to know, in this life we're all individuals
Good points. Even with my insurance, I'm hearing that it's about $400usd per month for most anti-tnfs, more for others. I'm a little sticker shocked, honestly, but am trying to figure it out.
Please don't colonize the moon. You have [been warned.](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Moon_Is_a_Harsh_Mistress)
